passages.title: Dialogue 1
passages.text: Woman: I've finally booked our trip to Spain for July! Man: That's great, but isn't it going to be extremely hot? Woman: I know, but we'll be right by the sea, so we can swim all day.

passages.title: Dialogue 2
passages.text: Man: Did you manage to pack everything for the camping trip? Woman: Almost, but I can't find the tent pegs. Man: Don't worry, I think I left them in the garage last time we went away.

passages.title: Dialogue 3
passages.text: Woman: I'm really looking forward to the city break, but I'm worried about the flight times. Man: Why? Woman: We have to be at the airport at 4 a.m. for the early departure.

passages.title: Dialogue 4
passages.text: Man: Should we take the train or drive to the coast? Woman: The train is much faster and we won't have to worry about finding a parking space in the busy town center.

passages.title: Dialogue 5
passages.text: Woman: Have you checked the weather forecast for our hiking trip? Man: Yes, it says it will be cloudy but dry, so we should be fine as long as we have warm jackets.

passages.title: Dialogue 6
passages.text: Man: I think we should stay in a hotel rather than a hostel this time. Woman: I agree, it's our anniversary, so let's treat ourselves to something a bit more comfortable.

questions.question: How does the woman feel about the summer heat in Spain?
questions.explanation: She acknowledges the heat but plans to stay cool by swimming in the sea.
options: a) She intends to manage it by being near the water.
b) She wants to change the dates.
c) She thinks it will be too uncomfortable.

questions.question: What is the problem with the camping equipment?
questions.explanation: The woman cannot find the tent pegs, but the man knows where they are.
options: a) The equipment is too heavy.
c) Some small items are missing.

questions.question: Why is the woman concerned about the flight?
questions.explanation: She is worried about the very early time they need to be at the airport.
options: a) The flight is too long.
c) The departure time is very early.

questions.question: Why does the woman prefer the train?
questions.explanation: She mentions speed and avoiding parking difficulties.
options: b) It is faster and avoids parking issues.
c) It is cheaper than driving.

questions.question: What will the weather be like for the hike?
questions.explanation: The forecast predicts cloudy but dry weather.
options: a) It will be cloudy but dry.
b) It will be rainy and cold.
c) It will be sunny and hot.

questions.question: Why do they decide to stay in a hotel?
questions.explanation: They want to celebrate their anniversary with more comfort.
options: b) To have a more comfortable experience.
c) Because the hostel is fully booked.
